attribution: Suyuan Liu and Molly Babel, University of British Columbia, MELI: Mandarin-English Language Interview, version 1.2
data_license: MELI-derived transcript outputs in this file: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; not the application MIT license. References, media and complete annotations are not included. Existing non-MELI controls retain their original source terms; no source media is redistributed.
scope: Real production/candidate models and WebAssembly with simulated HTTP, Cache and Worker transport in Node. Not browser, mobile UI, media decoding or full-video OCR end-to-end QA.
selection_roles: The first five new speakers were subsequently inspected and used for development/diagnosis. The last two speakers were fixed after the duration guard rule and used only as its final validation here; they are not unseen validation for every candidate.
completion_policy: Whisper reports require final completed_at and an ending COMPLETE log marker. SenseVoice reports are written only after all cases finish and all logged case IDs/texts are matched. Partial runs are not counted as completed.
new_recording_scope: Seven new recordings in these14 candidate runs; the additional two merge holdouts and full nine-recording campaign totals are in merge-results.json.

selection.rule: Participants fixed before annotations/audio. Enumerate entire continuous answers bounded by interviewer turns in explicit Interview task. Reject whole blocks containing xxx, @ or [REDACTED]. Trim non-speech-only edge annotations. Take first answer lasting 18–40 seconds. Keep internal pauses and disfluencies. Never filter by RMS, sound quality, ASR output or performance.
selection.accent_evidence: Public speaker language histories verify bilingual/regional-language background, not an independently assessed audible accent strength. English M01A reports learning English at 13; F02A reports English at 3 and Mandarin at 1. Mandarin F02B/M01B report childhood Henan/Xuzhou language use; their degree of Mandarin accent remains unverified.

extra_selection.reason: F02A original English case begins English at 3 and cannot be classified as necessarily non-native from metadata. Append F89A (Mandarin age 0, English age 8) as an unambiguous later-English learner; do not drop or replace prior four cases. No ASR outputs consulted.
